item.description: Researchers at Tohoku University and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency (JAEA) have successfully controlled a unique quantum phenomenon—the quantum-geometric nonlinear Hall (QgNLH) state—using electric current for the first time. item.description: A recent investigation revealed that dwarf galaxies only retain an average of 11% of the oxygen generated by their stars.
